subject: FinApps urgent: deployment mode decision and cutover plan
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Chandra <ravi.chandra@finapps.com>, Ops <ops@finapps.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: Deployment modes & next steps (post-call recap)

Ravi / FinApps team — thanks for the quick sync this morning. Short recap and asks so we have an agreed path forward: 

Summary of call:
- Current situation: FinApps experienced a tokenization latency spike during morning batch on 2026-05-29; hosted endpoints throttled and request queueing impacted UX.
- FinApps priority: eliminate tail latencies for real-time recommendation path (95th p95 target < 150ms) and keep PII inside VPC where possible.
- Options discussed: 1) Stay on Hosted + aggressive prefix caching + QoS routing, 2) Move to Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pool), 3) Private (VPC) deployment / on-prem evaluation.

Immediate asks from Redwood (what we need to decide this week):
1) Target SLOs for the affected endpoints (explicit 50/95/99 ms targets).
2) Whether FinApps requires customer-managed network (VPC) for all traffic or only for requests with PII.
3) A short list of top 3 models / sequence lengths so we can size Dedicated pool.

Attachments: draft SLA and a blank mutual action plan.

Proposed near-term move: start a 14-day Dedicated trial (reserved pool) to eliminate queuing while we work through VPC connectivity. If you confirm, we can provision a minimal Dedicated pool by EOD tomorrow and onboard via expedited template.

Next steps: please confirm SLOs and PII scope; if you want a Dedicated trial we’ll push provisioning and a pre-cutover test schedule.

— Marcus
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

From: Ravi Chandra <ravi.chandra@finapps.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Ops <ops@finapps.com>, security@finapps.com
Date: 2026-05-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment modes & next steps (post-call recap)

Marcus — appreciate the recap. Quick answers inline: 

- SLOs: 50ms (p50), 140ms (p95), 350ms (p99) for the recommendation endpoint. We can relax analytics batch paths.
- PII: Only the session payloads contain user identifiers; we need VPC for any request containing user_id. Non-identifying inference can remain on Hosted.
- Models: two models currently in prod: rec-small-bert (seq_len 256), rec-large-l2 (seq_len 512).

The incident yesterday caused a 9-minute degradation window during peak. Ops is nervous about repeating this ahead of next week’s marketing push. We want the Dedicated option to remove noisy neighbors and to isolate our workloads. If Dedicated can be provisioned fast (within 24 hours) with a rollback to Hosted, we’ll greenlight a trial.

We’ll also need an expedited SOC2 evidence checklist for procurement — transferring to security@finapps.com for that thread.

-Ravi
Director, Platform Engineering, FinApps Inc.

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T11:45:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: sizing & expedited provisioning for FinApps Dedicated trial

Folks — routing the finapps ask. Key provisioning notes: 
- Based on the two models and target SLOs, initial Dedicated pool recommendation: 4x A100-ish equivalents (mix of 2x for rec-large-l2 and 2x for rec-small-bert inference replicas), continuous batching disabled for rec-large-l2 to keep latency tight.
- Networking: need to open a VPC peering request only if Ravi confirms VPC for PII; otherwise we can route through our secure proxy.
- Timeline: we can create a minimal Dedicated pool in 8–12 hours if infra approves. We should pre-create credentials and onboarding docs (MAM) and schedule a 30-minute pre-cutover test with FinApps ops.

Blockers: legal/proc needs a short SOW + temporary SLA for the trial. Aditya — can you approve an expedited SOW sign-off (~$0 commitment for trial, billing kicks if usage continues post-trial)?

-Monica

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: sizing & expedited provisioning for FinApps Dedicated trial

Going to approve an expedited trial SOW under the following guardrails: 
1) Trial = 14 calendar days, not auto-renewing.
2) Trial capacity limited to the configuration Monica recommended.
3) Security checklist (SOC2 items) must be acknowledged by the customer and tracked.

Monica — legal will draft a 1-page trial SOW and send to Marcus for redline. Infra, please proceed with provisioning request — mark it as high priority.

-Aditya (Head of Sales Ops)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Ravi Chandra <ravi.chandra@finapps.com>, Ops <ops@finapps.com>, security@finapps.com
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-30T19:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment modes & next steps (post-call recap)

Thanks everyone — coordinated plan below and concrete asks to FinApps for EOD: 

Plan (agreed):
- Redwood to provision a 14-day Dedicated trial using the 4x GPU profile Monica specified.
- If FinApps confirms VPC for PII flows by 2026-05-31 12:00 PT, we’ll initiate VPC peering during trial day 1; otherwise we’ll route PII through our secure proxy with additional logging.
- Pre-cutover test window scheduled: 2026-06-01 08:00 PT — we’ll run a 30-minute hammer test and shared tracing.

FinApps EOD asks (please reply inline):
1) Confirm you want the Dedicated trial (yes/no).
2) Confirm VPC requirement for PII-only or full VPC ("PII-only" / "full").
3) Provide the contact and phone for the person who can sign the 1-page trial SOW on short notice.

If we don’t get confirmation by 2026-05-31 12:00 PT we’ll still provision the pool but keep it in a quarantined state until SOW acceptance.

— Marcus
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
